scope.own_tests: Temporary native C extraction compiled and run against actual local SDK Linux ROM implementation; existing fixture bytes only.

static_findings.subject: CRC32 semantics
static_findings.evidence: ESP-IDF esp_rom_crc.h documents complement on entry and exit and seed 0 for the first call. New BLE and text functions use seed 0 and carry returned CRC unchanged to subsequent chunks; no extra complement. Empty length returns 0 and does not dereference NULL. Polynomial/reflection remains IEEE CRC32 (0xEDB88320 reflected).

static_findings.subject: size_t and target narrowing
static_findings.evidence: SIZE_MAX > UINT32_MAX conditional splits wider hosts into nonzero uint32_t chunks; data pointer advances by exactly the consumed count and length monotonically decreases. S3 size_t is 32-bit, so the comparison is removed. BLE enqueue still bounds messages to 2304 bytes; accepted text packets are bounded by existing encoder buffers. No size_t truncation is introduced.
static_findings.limitation: CRC input above 4 GiB was not allocated/executed. The branch is statically reviewed; official ROM cumulative-call semantics was independently exercised on ordinary data. Such buffers are outside the actual S3 and accepted packet domain.

static_findings.subject: planner byte accounting
static_findings.evidence: Fixed header cost is 18 bytes: G, seven commas, one newline, one channel byte, eight uppercase CRC hex digits. Add exactly five uint32 decimal widths; zero has width 1 and UINT32_MAX width 10. Maximum 68 remains below the 80-byte buffer. %08lX consumes exactly 8 for the uint32_t CRC even on the 64-bit host. Wider chunk/messageLength is explicitly rejected before narrowing.

static_findings.subject: fragment selection and wire
static_findings.evidence: The fragment-search function, base/remainder splitting, tinyTail update and actual SendFragment snprintf/size/error checks are byte-for-byte unchanged. Every accepted message remains <=2304; MTU-derived payload maximum is still capped at 512. No scheduler, slot ownership, retry/deadline, connection/epoch, format, endpoint or PHY change.

static_findings.subject: three CRC layers and errors
static_findings.evidence: Text-frame CRC production/self-check, BLE enqueue CRC, and dequeue recomputation/rejection remain present. No CRC mismatch, SDK error, context/connection error or fragment size failure is swallowed. The public send and error-handling functions are unchanged, with hashes below.

static_findings.subject: ROM dependency and actual S3 target
static_findings.evidence: The actual SDK common component requirements include esp_rom; no additional application CMake dependency is needed. esp32s3.rom.api.ld maps esp_rom_crc32_le to crc32_le, and esp32s3.rom.ld defines crc32_le=0x40001c98. The host reference is not target ROM execution.
static_findings.remaining_target_check: In the parent target build, verify crc32_le/esp_rom_crc32_le resolve to 0x40001c98 and caller disassembly/relocations from the changed functions reach that symbol; then retain real received wire CRC/identity results on the attested candidate.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent read-only production extraction; run only after freeze.
The SDK's Linux ROM implementation is a semantic oracle, not target ROM execution.
"""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,time
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/csc/esp/workspace/SensorArray')
SDK=pathlib.Path('/home/csc/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.5')
TMP=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE='a656d53'
PATHS=['components/sensorarrayBle/sensorarrayBle.c','main/output/sensorarrayTextProtocol.c']
def run(args,**kw): return subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,**kw)
def old(p): return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',BASE+':'+p],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
def fun(s,n):
 m=re.search(r'^(?:static\s+)?(?:bool|size_t|uint32_t)\s+'+re.escape(n)+r'\(',s,re.M)
 assert m,n
 start=m.start(); a=s.index('{',m.end()); level=1; pos=a+1
 # The extracted functions contain no unmatched brace in literals/comments.
 while level:
  level += (s[pos]=='{')-(s[pos]=='}');pos+=1
 return s[start:pos]
def block(s):
 f=fun(s,'sensorarrayBleGetSendGeneration'); start=s.index(f)+len(f)
 end=s.index('static void sensorarrayBlePrepareConfirmation',start)
 return s[start:end]
sources={p:(ROOT/p).read_text() for p in PATHS}
head='''#include <assert.h>\n#include <stdbool.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\n#include <string.h>\n#include <limits.h>\n#include "esp_rom_crc.h"\n#define SENSORARRAY_BLE_TINY_TAIL_MIN 8u\n#define SENSORARRAY_BLE_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BUFFER_SIZE 80u\n#define SENSORARRAY_BLE_FRAGMENT_HEADER_FIXED_CHARS (sizeof("G,,,,,,,\\n") - 1u)\n#define SENSORARRAY_BLE_U32_HEX_MAX_CHARS 8u\n#define SENSORARRAY_BLE_MESSAGE_VALUE_MAX 2304u\nstruct { struct { uint32_t tinyTailCount; } stats; } s_ble;\nstatic void sensorarrayBleStatsIncrement(uint32_t *v) { ++*v; }\n'''
pieces=[head]
for prefix,txt in [('baseline',old(PATHS[0])),('candidate',sources[PATHS[0]])]:
 for part in [fun(txt,'sensorarrayBleCrc32'),block(txt)]:
  # Keep the single shared counter stub; rename only private computation helpers.
  part=re.sub(r'\bsensorarrayBle(?!StatsIncrement)(\w+)\b',prefix+r'\1',part)
  pieces.append(part)
for prefix,txt in [('baseline',old(PATHS[1])),('candidate',sources[PATHS[1]])]:
 pieces.append(fun(txt,'sensorarrayTextCrc32').replace('sensorarrayTextCrc32',prefix+'TextCrc32'))
main=TMP/'main.c.txt'
assert main.exists(), 'write the independent test driver before executing'
pieces.append(main.read_text())
code='\n'.join(pieces); c=TMP/'extracted.c';c.write_text(code)
cc=['cc','-std=c11','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-DESP_PLATFORM=1','-DCONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ESP32S3=1','-I'+str(SDK/'components/esp_rom/include'),str(c),str(SDK/'components/esp_rom/linux/esp_rom_crc.c'),'-o',str(TMP/'independent')]
a=run(cc,timeout=60); (TMP/'compile.stdout.txt').write_text(a.stdout);(TMP/'compile.stderr.txt').write_text(a.stderr)
result={'schema_version':1,'baseline':BASE,'candidate_source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest() for p,s in sources.items()},'compile_command':cc,'compile_exit':a.returncode,'compile_stdout':a.stdout,'compile_stderr':a.stderr,'harness_sha256':hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest(),'SDK_oracle':str(SDK/'components/esp_rom/linux/esp_rom_crc.c'),'SDK_oracle_sha256':hashlib.sha256((SDK/'components/esp_rom/linux/esp_rom_crc.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'target_execution':False}
if a.returncode==0:
 fixtures=sorted((ROOT/'tests/fixtures/config_identity').glob('*.frame'))+sorted((ROOT/'tests/fixtures/reference_capture').glob('*.recorded.txt'))
 args=[str(TMP/'independent'),*[str(f) for f in fixtures]];started=time.monotonic();b=run(args,timeout=60)
 result.update(run_command=args,run_exit=b.returncode,run_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,stdout=b.stdout,stderr=b.stderr)
 (TMP/'run.stdout.txt').write_text(b.stdout);(TMP/'run.stderr.txt').write_text(b.stderr)
result['candidate_sources_unchanged']=all((ROOT/p).read_text()==s for p,s in sources.items())
(TMP/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['compile_exit','run_exit','run_seconds','stdout','stderr','candidate_sources_unchanged'] if k in result},indent=2))
sys.exit(result.get('run_exit',a.returncode))
